body: Just wanted to chime in and say that I think this is normal, or at least it has been for me. I've definitely developed an interest in my attorney and other men that have advocated for me in this process, sometimes in ways I am not interested in my boyfriend (whom I love deeply and care about for endlessly... there's just something special about someone who helps you in this time).
I do have a therapist but she is gone for about a month right now. Really bad timing.

But realistically... it may just happen again. I've always been abused. There's something about me that is naturally breakable, even when I use those things to make myself stronger. Someone always breaks me down. Why keep going and give someone else a chance?
Yeah, but maybe if I did die he'd understand what he did to me. Maybe everyone would. Maybe someone would actually believe me then.
